meta.summary: No board vote on parental notification, student names/pronouns, or AB 1955 was found for any of the 40 roster boards. Web search surfaces almost only non-LA-County districts (Chino Valley, Murrieta, Temecula, Orange, Rocklin, Cajon Valley). BoardDocs/Simbli agenda systems were not searchable through the tools available, so 'nothing found' means 'not found in news/web search', not 'no vote occurred'. No candidate own-words on this exact question found.

The topic of the underlying question is NOT confirmed from the extraction; re-read the full article before using. Positive control: person found.
